classification.difficultyReason: Same as p49-q8: set up an exponential, solve with logs, and convert the fractional part to a smaller unit.

children.label: a
children.prompt:
Under a continuous exponential model, a bacteria culture doubles in size every 3 hours. If there are 200 bacteria at the start, after how long will there be 1 million bacteria?
Give your answer in whole hours and the nearest minute.

answer.worked:
Let $t\geq0$ be the elapsed time in hours.
$$\begin{align*}200(2)^{t/3}&=1000000\\2^{t/3}&=5000\\\frac t3&=\log_2 5000\\t&=3\log_2 5000\approx36.863\end{align*}$$
There are 36 whole hours. The remaining time is $0.863\times60\approx51.8$ minutes. To the nearest minute, the time is 36 hours 52 minutes.

children.label: b
children.prompt:
Under a continuous exponential model, the number of views of a video triples every day. If it has 500 views at the start, after how long will it have 5 million views?
Give your answer in whole days and the nearest hour.

answer.worked:
Let $d\geq0$ be the elapsed time in days.
$$\begin{align*}500(3)^d&=5000000\\3^d&=10000\\d&=\log_3 10000\approx8.3836\end{align*}$$
There are 8 whole days. The remaining time is $0.3836\times24\approx9.2$ hours. To the nearest hour, the time is 8 days 9 hours.
